name: storm_night
_note: Three related-but-different reports on one street. B4's linker should merge them into ONE incident. Phone numbers are fictional 555 numbers; the demo_resident report gets DEMO_RESIDENT_PHONE from .env.

reports.transcript: The storm drain on the corner of Figueroa and Avenue 52 is completely blocked and water is pooling.
There's water all the way across Figueroa near Avenue 53. Cars are slowing right down.
A car is stuck in the water by Avenue 54. The driver got out but the water keeps coming.
